title: Sitting in with unfamiliar musicians and getting used to the band
summary: Players need time to learn his band's style; examples include a drummer in Santa Cruz and uneven time at the Dixieland Hall.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
